name: mafia-media-sfu
description: Standalone mediasoup SFU sidecar for the Mafia extension's voice/video (plan Phase 7). Not a Laravel/PHP process — a separate Node.js service the quiz app's Play page connects to directly over WebSocket, authorized by a short-lived signed token the Laravel app issues. Game rules never live here: every consume request is authorized by asking Laravel's internal can-view endpoint, so this service only ever needs to know 'is this token valid' and 'what did Laravel just say' — never why.
